svg.title: Forty Funded Placements Support the Base Case
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-annual-placement-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: Forty Funded Placements Support the Base Case; subtitle: One annual borrower cohort; every downstream count is a subset.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative steady-state annual cohort, not a first-month forecast. Count each financing opportunity once and exclude duplicate lender submissions. Forty funded, fee-retaining placements at $14,000 average retained compensation produce $560,000 operator gross revenue.; caption: Stage conversion rates are 60.0%, 50.0%, 53.3%, and 62.5%; overall conversion is 10.0%. The $14,000 fee is a modeled average, not a market quotation.; stages: label: Permissioned opportunities; value: 400 annual opportunities; numeric value: 400.0; detail: Source documented borrower introductions through accountants, equipment dealers, and existing relationships. Deduplicate financing requests before measuring acquisition cost or assigning the relationship manager.; label: Qualified financing requests; value: 240 | 60.0% of prior stage; numeric value: 240.0; detail: Retain borrowers whose business purpose, geography, financing size, and timing fit the desk's permitted scope and at least one current lender appetite.; label: Complete lender-ready files; value: 120 | 50.0% of prior stage; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Require current financial evidence, a reconciled debt schedule, appropriate collateral documentation, and authorized distribution before counting a file as complete.; label: Accepted conditional terms; value: 64 | 53.3% of prior stage; numeric value: 64.0; detail: Count borrower-accepted lender terms with remaining closing conditions logged. Do not recognize brokerage fees merely because an indicative offer was issued.; label: Funded and fee-retaining placements; value: 40 | 62.5% of prior stage; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Reconcile 40 placements times $14,000 to $560,000 retained annual fee revenue. Exclude failed closings and amounts reversed or unearned; maintain a separate contingent-compensation exposure register.

text.title: Forty Funded Placements Support the Base Case
text.tspan: Forty Funded Placements Support the Base Case

circle.title: label: Permissioned opportunities; value: 400 annual opportunities; numeric value: 400.0; detail: Source documented borrower introductions through accountants, equipment dealers, and existing relationships. Deduplicate financing requests before measuring acquisition cost or assigning the relationship manager.

label: Qualified financing requests; value: 240 | 60.0% of prior stage; numeric value: 240.0; detail: Retain borrowers whose business purpose, geography, financing size, and timing fit the desk's permitted scope and at least one current lender appetite.

label: Complete lender-ready files; value: 120 | 50.0% of prior stage; numeric value: 120.0; detail: Require current financial evidence, a reconciled debt schedule, appropriate collateral documentation, and authorized distribution before counting a file as complete.

label: Accepted conditional terms; value: 64 | 53.3% of prior stage; numeric value: 64.0; detail: Count borrower-accepted lender terms with remaining closing conditions logged. Do not recognize brokerage fees merely because an indicative offer was issued.

label: Funded and fee-retaining placements; value: 40 | 62.5% of prior stage; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Reconcile 40 placements times $14,000 to $560,000 retained annual fee revenue. Exclude failed closings and amounts reversed or unearned; maintain a separate contingent-compensation exposure register.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative steady-state annual cohort, not a first-month forecast. Count each financing opportunity once and exclude duplicate lender submissions. Forty funded, fee-retaining placements at $14,000 average retained compensation produce $560,000 operator gross revenue.
